# Clean the dock washing system

[All care guides](README.md)

![Clean the dock washing system](../img/wash_dock--dock_washing_system.svg)

**What it does**

The dock's washing system flushes dirt out of the mop. Residue left in it means the mop comes out dirty.

**How to**

1. Lift the wash insert out of the dock.
2. Rinse it under running water and clear hair and debris from its openings.
3. Wipe the seat of the insert in the dock.
4. Put the insert back so that it sits flat.

> **Note** No cleaning agents unless the dock's manual allows them.
